title: Spiritual Practice Dashboard Freshness
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:ops signal_name=* signal_current=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(signal_current="yes",1,0))) as matched by signal_name
| eval a_current_signal_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_current_signal_pct
description: Measures the percentage of spiritual practice tracking that end with a current signal by practice signal.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which practice signal are helping or hurting spiritual practice tracking.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a current signal` on `faith:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `signal_name`.
visualization: Table of practice signal with percentage of spiritual practice tracking ending with a current signal.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how often a current signal happens for each practice signal so you can see where spiritual practice tracking go smoothly or get stuck.
